summary_en: KOKUYO will cancel 24.0 million shares on November 26, 2026, representing 5.4% of issued shares including treasury stock. The company is lowering its treasury stock retention target from 2% to 1% of issued shares to improve capital efficiency and address dilution concerns.
title_en: Notice of Cancellation of Treasury Stock and Change in Treasury Stock Cancellation Policy
translation_en_brief:
On October 29, 2026, KOKUYO's Board of Directors resolved to cancel 24.0 million shares of common stock pursuant to Article 178 of the Companies Act. The cancellation is scheduled to take effect on November 26, 2026. The shares to be cancelled represent 5.4% of issued shares including treasury stock. After cancellation, the total issued shares (including treasury stock) will be 416,969,852 shares.

Simultaneously, the company is revising its treasury stock management policy. The target level for retained treasury stock is being reduced from 2% or less of issued shares to 1% or less. Under the revised policy, any treasury stock holdings exceeding the 1% threshold will be cancelled on a continuous basis in principle. The company cited two objectives for these actions: improving capital efficiency and alleviating shareholder concerns about share dilution.
